references.text: Immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.
Then Peter spoke up and said to him: 'See, we have left everything and followed you. What then will there be for us?'
And when they had brought the boats to land, they left everything and followed him.
Then Peter said: 'See, we have left our homes and followed you.'
He regarded Christ's disgrace as greater wealth than Egypt's treasures, for he looked forward to the reward.
